capabilities: Fix spelling of selected text via LanguageTool
Rewrite selected text with AI without changing its meaning
Pick a text kind such as bug report, summary, title, or message
Preview, edit, copy, or retry AI results before applying
Give custom rewrite instructions like 'make it more formal'
extras: Works with no setup: the default engine sends text through the plugin's Cloudflare server, which uses Gemini with a shared free limit of 6 requests per minute per IP. On Gemini's free plan Google may use the sent text to improve its models; only the selected text is ever sent. UI and examples are largely in Portuguese, with Brazilian Portuguese as the default spell-check language. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
problem: Obsidian's spellcheck only flags mistakes and offers no way to correct or rewrite selected text in place with one command.

relations.evidence: Corrigir ortografia fixes spelling with LanguageTool, right away.
the text goes through the plugin's server, which uses Google Gemini
Ollama: runs on your own computer, so the text never leaves it.

summary: Text polisher that fixes spelling of selected text with LanguageTool and rewrites it with AI while protecting Markdown syntax.
